newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 30.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Wednesday:
* The benchmark stock index is expected to once again test the 10,000-point level on Wednesday after failing to break it in the previous session, brokers said.
* "But strong psychological and technical pressure might erase early gains, forcing the index to close below the 10,000 level," said Oliver Fang of National Securities.
* Lei Pei-yu of Pacific Securities said: "The index should be able to close high on moderate gains by various sectors."
